MASTER_PAD_VERSION_INFO.MASTER_PAD_INFO: Portable Application Description, or PAD for short, is a data set that is used by shareware authors to disseminate information to anyone interested in their software products. To find out more go to http://pad.asp-software.org

Program_Info.Program_Change_Info: Group cue timing, time-gated stage memos, multi-screen pop-out windows, saved monitor history, bass/guitar tabs with transposition.

English.Keywords: show control, cue player, qlab alternative, theater, live sound, midi, click track, stage monitor, prompter
English.Char_Desc_45: Show control and cue playback for Windows
English.Char_Desc_80: Live show control with audio and MIDI cues and stage monitors on phones
English.Char_Desc_250: Modern, low-latency show control and cue playback for Windows and web. Audio and MIDI cues, click track generator, and real-time stage monitors, lyrics and tabs on musicians' phones via QR code. A Windows alternative to QLab.
English.Char_Desc_450: StageCue is a show control and cue playback app for theater, bands and live sound. Play audio cues with fades and pre-waits, send and receive MIDI, control everything from a USB foot pedal, and generate click tracks with tempo ramps. Musicians scan a QR code to see lyrics, memos, tabs and Now and Next on their phones. Floating windows with grid and magnet snap, and pop-out for multiple screens. Free tier, Pro optional.
English.Char_Desc_2000: StageCue is a modern show control and cue playback application for live sound engineers, theater productions, bands and solo performers - a Windows alternative to Mac-only tools like QLab. Features: low-latency audio cues with fades, pre-wait and auto-continue; groups with timed child cues; MIDI send/receive with MIDI Learn for foot pedals; click track generator with tempo ramps and hold; stage monitors on phones and tablets via QR code with lyrics, time-gated memos, cue notes per role and pro bass/guitar tabs (4-8 strings) with transposition; floating windows with free, grid and magnet snap modes and pop-out to extra screens; autosave to a local .stagecue file; audio stays on your own PC. Available in 7 languages. Free tier available; Pro unlocks advanced features (monthly, yearly or lifetime).
